statement.zh: **协议**：GmSSL 开源国密套件（GmSSL Open-Source Chinese Cryptography Suite）。GmSSL 是开源国密实现，不是 GM/T 标准本身；该条目把套件写成 SM2/SM3/SM4/TLCP 四项与握手链，具体 API、版本与测试向量以仓库和标准文本为准。
statement.en: **Protocol**: GmSSL Open-Source Chinese Cryptography Suite (GmSSL 开源国密套件).GmSSL is an open-source Chinese cryptography implementation, not a GM/T standard.

statement.en: In the 中国国密 reading path, GmSSL Open-Source Chinese Cryptography Suite connects to government, finance contexts; the main risks are protocol.
